notes: Clean security walk: no quantified, reproducible exploit introduced by the server chunk. Every new mutating route (POST /profile, /profile/style, /profile/test, /welcome/bootstrap, /sessions/{scope}/archive, /sessions/archive/{name}/unarchive|delete, /repos/add git-init) sits behind the unchanged sameOriginGuard (Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin check), so a cross-site page cannot forge them; the caller is otherwise the local user, who already owns every file these handlers touch. Subprocesses take user input only as positional argv ("$1"/"$2"/"$3" under bash -c, git init with fixed args), never interpolated into the script string. Templates use html/template autoescaping; the only template.HTML producers (nameWrap, pathWrap) escape each segment first. Token values never reach a template or a log line (TokenName is the label; profile test and bootstrap pass the token path, bash reads the file). Cross-chunk items for the station (not verifiable inside this chunk): (1) cmd/bootstrap/run.sh consumes BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT — bootstrapEnv rejects only quotes and newlines, so $ ` \ reach the wrapper; safe only if run.sh never evals or re-splices it into a shell string. (2) sessions.ArchiveScope/UnarchiveScope/DeleteScope receive r.PathValue values, which Go's ServeMux unescapes (%2F, ..); traversal safety depends on internal/sessions name validation. (3) Whether cmd/bootstrap/run.sh echoes the token file content into the bootstrap log. Pre-existing, outside the diff and not reported: sameOriginGuard compares Origin host to r.Host with no Host allowlist, so a DNS-rebinding page on the 127.0.0.1:6001 listener passes it — this predates the change and every capability the new routes add (agent prompt, paid run) was already reachable via /routines/{name}/run and /api/permissions/add. The bootstrap log at os.TempDir()/smine-bootstrap.log (0644, O_CREATE without O_EXCL) is per-user on macOS/Windows; its location is already carried by known correctness-BLK-5-r1, so not re-reported. No scope removed: the security relevance filter excludes only docs/README/txt/LICENSE, none of which are in this chunk.
